description.value:
Some souls don't want to leave, and you don't ask twice. A Pyre forces the passage through resistance — the ferrying itself becomes an attack, not a mercy.

FORCED PASSAGE — can attempt a Passing on an unwilling target as a hostile action, at a steeper Passage cost. The target gets a Will save against your class DC to resist.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's own flags.cinderfall.followUp already states the signature spell 'The Pyre' still needs its own spell document -- a self-acknowledged placeholder, not a newly found gap. This card is also the parent that Forced Passage, Wider fails to extend: its own baseline Forced Passage mechanic (a Will save vs. class DC) is prose-only, with no rule element built for it yet either.
